tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba chos kyi grags pa'i rnam par thar pa'i cha shas tsam brjod pa bzhugs so//

kun la phan byed dga' ston bya ba'i snying rje dang*// ba spu gcig la'ang gus pa'i bsod nams grangs med tshogs// thos shes sangs rgyas rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog nyid la// yang yang phyag bgyi khyod kyi ngang tshul cha tsam brjod// rdo rje'i gsung gi rang gi gtam// chu gter dman pa'i mdun sbas te// cha tsam bum chu ltar sbrengs pa// mtshar phyin 'di ko bdag gis bsags// gtam bzang sngon med bai ḍūrya'i// phreng ba yul brda srad bu la// 'os min snyan ngag snyan pa'i tshig /gser gyi skud pa kho nar sbrengs// rtogs brjod rin chen ri mo ni// rnam dpyod pir gyis gang bris pa// lo grangs bye ba bye bar yang*// nub pa zhes bya yod pa min// de ltar yul dam pa la mchod par brjod cing gleng bslang ba'i sgo phye ste/ thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab dang*/ rnam par dpyod pa'i mig gis dam pa'i tshul la cung zad bsam na 'di ltar shes te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rang gi ngang gis gzhan la phan pa'i ngang tshul las ma g.yos par gdon mi za ba nyid du grub pa yin no// rgyu mtshan de'i phyir sangs rgyas la byas pa shes shing drin du gzo ba'i rab tu dang ba ni 'bras bu yod pa nyid du ma zad tshad med pa'i 'bras bu thob pas shin tu dad pa bskyed par bya'o// de la gus pa yang yon tan phul du dbyung du med pa rnam par thar pa'i tshul thos pa dang*/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa 'chad pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kun chub par byed pa dang*/ gzhan la rgya cher ston pa las 'byung ba yin pas/ 'dir yang dam pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa gting mi g.yo zhing shin tu zab pas na rgya mtsho chen po'i do zlar gyur pa nyid las ba spu gcig gi rtse mor chags pa'i zegs ma tsam gyi yon tan gyi cha shas rang nyid kyi blo dang rjes su 'tsham par brjod pa la spro ba rgya chen rgyas par gyur to// de yang 'di skad thos te/

lnga brgya tha ma rtsod ldan dang bcas pa'i dus su gnod gnas kyi phyogs kha ba can gyi ri rgyud du mi'i 'dren pa bdud las rgyal ba ratna shrī zhes 'jig rten gyi khams su grags shing nga'i bstan pa la bya ba byed par 'gyur ro// de ni khong khro dang bral zhing zab chos de dang de dag gi bdag por yang rjes su bsngags so// de rnams la 'di skad ces bya ste/ gang gis spyad pa'i rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' su yis dpog par nus// brtse ba'i byams dang snying rje'i rba rlabs g.yo la'ang nyin mtshan med// sangs rgyas ye shes lnga po rin chen rin thang tshad dang bral// dad pas ded dpon dam pa'i ched brjod gru yi sbyor ba byed// sangs rgyas blta skabs ma thob la// tshangs pa yang ni ma mthong mod// bden pa kho na ston pa la// dpyad tshe rgyal des bdag yid brkus// rtsod dang bcas dus ring po na// kai la sha yi ri nang du// mi yi 'dren pa ratna shrī// grags pa sa la 'khyud par 'byung*// brgyad cu'i sa ya phrag gi grangs// 'dus bcas bstan la bya ba byed| |dus gsum rgyal ba'i phreng du yang*// gnas dang mtshan gyis gsal bar bstan// de nyid slar yang 'gro kun la// dga' ba'i rin chen 'bar ba des// chos sku gcig tu byin brlabs pa// rig pa 'dzin rgyal khyod nyid lags// dpal mchog dang po'i dbyar gyi rngas// gdug pa can kun snying 'gas pa/ /he ru ka pa grub pa der// padma saṃ bha'i lung gis grags| |lha sras lha yi rnam rol can// 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi khrir 'dug pa// de nyid nas ni da lta'i bar// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i bstan pa bsrungs// yang ni bde gshegs seng ge'i bkas| |klu yi ring lugs 'degs pa la// gnyis pa med pa'i sha ra bha// zla ba'i zhabs su khyod bsgrags so// zhes sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gtam gzhan yang 'di ltar thos te/ 'dren pa mchog 'di zla dgon zhes bya bar bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i bsnyen sgrub dang rjes su 'brel ba'i smin par byed pa'i cho gas skal ldan mang po rdo rje'i sa la bkri bar mdzad pa'i skabs shig sman pa mgo rlon zhes bya bas dus de'i ring tho rangs kyi tshe thog ma'i skyems stob par yi dam bcas pa/

nyin gcig dbang bskur ba brtsams pa'i gral du 'dug pa na 'dren pa mchog 'di ma hā gu ru drag po rtsal smug nag srin po'i cha byad kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ 'jigs pa la 'jigs pa ster ba zhig gi skur mthong nas dngangs skrag dran pa med par gyur pa na phyag gi dril bu'i sgra thos ma thag sad de gdong mchi ma dang bcas shing lta bar mi bzod pa tsam du 'dar bzhin dal bus bltas pa na sku dngos nyid du mthong yang de phyin chad 'jigs pa'i snang ba rgyud mar byung nas zhabs drung du 'gror mi spobs pa/ brtson 'grus zhes bya bas gdas par gsol ba na/ de'i tshul dngos nyid la dri ba mdzad pas ngu zhing dbugs dron mo dang bcas rgyas par gsol bas/ de ni sngon mchog gi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ kho bo 'jigs med seng ge zhes bya bar gyur pa na/ khyod za hor rgyal po'i bu sdig to can du skyes pa/ zhi ba'i snod du ma gyur pas rnam par shes pa chos dbyings su spar nas sha khrag tshogs 'khor du rol bas de'i bag chags sad pa yin pas skyon med de/ phyin chad las dbang gis 'khor bar mi 'khyam pa kho bos shes so// zhes dbugs phyung bas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par gyur to// gzhan yang sangs rgyas drug pa seng ges mgon po klu sgrub kyi phrin las bsgrub pa'i slad du dpal ldan zla ba grags pa de nyid spyan snga 'bri gung gling par sprul nas dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i chos kyi sgo dang tshul dang snang ba chen po mu med par skad cig tsam du phyes pa'i yun la'ang sems can gang dag nyan rang gi 'bras bu la bkod pa dang*/ mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa chen po thob pa la bkod pa dang*/ mngon par mtho ba'i rten la bkod pa'i grangs ni 'phags chen rnams kyis kyang bgrang bar ga la nus/ zhes bka' stsal pa na/ theg pa mchog la thugs gzhol ba mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje mnga' ba/

ri mor bris pa'i ba drus ma las 'o ma bzhos pas bden par zhen pa ldog par mdzad pa de yang bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul par shes te/ dpal 'bri gung pa chen po'i thugs kyi sras sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa gcig par ston pa'i khyad chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa chen po de bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyi rnam par sprul pa yin par yang nas yang du bka' stsal pas/ de sogs dus gsum gyi rnam par thar pa zab rgyas mang du bzhugs pa ni rnam thar nyid mdzad pas dngos dang shugs kyis rtogs par bya'o// yang zla dgon du grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' lhun grub las mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par gsan te/ sor sdud mtshan mo gseng med mun pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ nyin mo sprin med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rnams thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul ston pa na/ dpal ldan rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ nam mkha' kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang mig ni mi 'dzum rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yin// stong pa las ni du ba smig rgyu rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid dang mar me dang*| |'bar ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rdo rje rnams dang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur// de yi dbus su sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag ni rnal 'byor pa yi bgrad pa'i mig gis blta bar bya ba ste// re kha nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong bar 'gyur gyi bar du'o| |de la kun mkhyen gzugs ni chu la nyi ma lta bu gos pa med pa kha dog sna tshogs te// rnam pa kun ldan rang sems yul dang rnam par 'brel ba dag go gzhan gyi sems ni min pa nyid| |ces gsungs pa ltar gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu ma lus pa mngon du mdzad de/

sngon gyi skye ba'i phreng ba mang po nas lam 'di nas lam 'di brten nas spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa zhig 'dir sad pa tsam mo zhes/ yongs su 'dzin pa des kyang rgya cher bsgrags te gzhon nu byis pa'i tshul ston pa nyid kyi tshe/ yab chos kyi rgyal po dpal he ru kas khyod ci sgom pa yin zhes dris pa na/ nga sbyor drug bsgoms pa yin zhes bka' bstsal bas kyang gsal bar byas so// bla ma 'di las mnga' bdag mar pa'i snyan gyi shog dril bzhi dang*/ nā ro'i gsang spyod/ blo sbyong don bdun ma/ blo sbyong mtshon cha'i 'khor lo sogs mang du gsan pa'i tshul bstan/ spyir gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po las kyang*/ bde stong phyag rgya chen po nyid la bsngags shing phyis spro lung du dbon po karma bshad sgrub mthar phyin gyis gsol ba btab par/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang*/ mchog dbang gong ma gsum dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa bzhi pa'i mthar thug pa mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil ltar/ phyag len rnam par dag pa legs par bshad pa'i brda don 'phrod nges stsal cing*/ lo de'i dgun rin chen brag bla ma rin chen sbyin pa dang*/ rtogs ldan mchad kha bas zhus te skal ba mchog tu gyur pa'i gdul bya nga rgyal med pa nyer lnga tsam la rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i dga' ston stsal te/ gdul bya mchog de rnams kyis kyang rnal 'byor gyi rim pa la rtse gcig tu 'jug pa dang*/ byed 'chings 'khrul 'khor sogs kyang tshig tu ma lus par phyag khrid mdzad de zung 'jug rdo rje'i lam mchog tu gsal bar gyur to// gzhan yang chos kyi rdzong chen por bya khyung pa rgyal dbang padma bstan 'dzin yab sras la mgyogs khrid dang*/ bka' brgyud pho brang gi bla ma chos rje sku skye dpon slob la'ang khrid lung gnang ba sogs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho nas kyang mchog tu gyur pa'i gdul bya mang po rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la bkod pa nyid do// bi ma la mi tra'i thugs sras myang ting 'dzin bzang po'i sprul par zhal gyis bzhes shing de nyid skyes chen phal cher gyis tshad mar bsngags pa rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter chos/

mnyam med sgam po pa chen po'i gseng lam bla ma sgrub pa sogs sgam po mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug la sngon nas gsan/ phyis gter ston chen po de nyid brag kha brgyud de bla ma mchog 'di'i drung du phebs te gus pa chen pos zhabs pad gtsug nor du bkod cing mchod sprin gyi tshogs spros pa la/ khong nyid kyis gter chos ji snyed pa'i dbang lung bka' gtad dang bcas pa phul nas/ kho bo'i gter chos spyi dang khyad par tshe dpag med gnam lcags rdo rje'i dngos grub kun 'dus kyi bka' bab gtso bo dang*/ thugs rje chen po ngan song rang grol gyi'ang chos bdag lung bstan du gsal bas chos 'di rnams kyi 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad par gsal lo| |dpal mgon po ma ning gi skor rnams de skabs gtan 'bebs ma grub pas ma sgrig pa chen po zhig 'dug pa bka' gtad mdzad nas/ 'di nyid kyi bdag po'ang nyid lags pas rjes su phab grub 'phral dpe phul ma thag thugs kyi dpal be'ur sim zhing skal ba dang ldan pa la rjes su gdams pa dang*/ zhi sogs las rab 'byams sgrub par mdzod cig ces gsal lo// bu chu lha khang nas gter du bzhes pa'i dzhai kṣim gyi nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi gtso bo bstan pa'i bdag po'i sku dang*/ tsandan sbrul gyi snying po las grub pa'i o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po'i sku brnyan ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i dpal 'dzin pa dang*/ shog ser skye bdun gyi ril bu mtsho rgyal gyi phyag mtheb a tham gyis spras pa mang po dam rdzas rol pa chen po'i phab rgyun sogs phul zhing yun ring du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin bzhugs par gsol ba btab/ gter ston nyid sngon rje gong ma'i skabs zhabs 'bring ba dge slong gsang mda' ba zhes bya bar gyur tshul sogs sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i tshul mang po dpon slob gnyis ka nas mol mchid mdzad do// de'i tshe kun gsal gyi bu mo'i 'gram par dbang po'i tshon ris dang mu tig dmar po'i 'phreng ba dang*/

ku mu da'i rgyun 'bab kyis kun nas g.yogs shing*/ a ka ru dang kha ba'i bye ma dang sa mchog sogs kyi dri bzang po rtag tu 'gro ba'i bzhon pa la zhon te phyogs kyi cha thams cad rgyas par bkang skad do// mes po dang*/ mchod sbyin brgya pa dang*/ bde byed dang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ smin drug gi bu la sogs sngags kyi srung ma rnams kyis rdo rje theg pa'i rnam 'gyur gsar du shar bar rig nas dga' bas mchod sprin spros par gdon mi za'o// gter ston nyid la'ang dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma'i khyad par gyi chos dgongs pa gcig pa dang*/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying po dang*/ zab gter yang zab/ yid bzhin nor mchog /rje gong ma rin chen phun tshogs kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung sogs stsal kyang thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur pa yin no// de rnams la 'di skad bya ste/ 'dren pa dang por mchod 'dod des// srin po shin tu khros pa zhig /gang las byung snyam bros pa na// shin tu zhi ba nyid du mthong*// 'gro ba'i bla mas dris pa na// pus mo sa la btsugs nas smras// ma 'jigs khyod kyi sdig pa dang*// 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sdug bsngal bcad// de thos ya mtshan gyur nas mig /bgrad pa dang bcas bde bar 'khod// snying rje'i dbang du gyur pa la// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal khur yin te// de las kyang ni skyob pa'i bstan// 'degs la so gnyis dbang po bzhin// rigs kyi bdag po'i lci ba'i bka'// gnya' shing bzhin du 'dzin pa des// don gyi dge ba slong ba yin// brtul zhugs nam yang 'dor ba min// rgol ba nga rgyal smag rum gtibs// lta ngan mkha' snang kun tu brgyugs// shar ba tsam gyis tshar gcod pa'i// 'jigs dang bral ba zla ba nyid// klu sgrub ces byas sngon med kyi// seng ge'i sgra chen yang bsgrags pa// dgongs pa gcig pa'i chos kyi dung*// khyod nyid kho nar 'dzin du bcug

/rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor gyi// thog ma bar dang mthar dge la| |rang nyid gnas par ma zad de// skal bzang thams cad bde bar khrid// padma'i gsung gis yang dang yang*// khyod la bsngags pa'i rgyal rnga brdungs// khyod kyis kyang ni de yi bstan| |nyi ma bzhin du gsal bar mdzad// brgya byin la yang mi 'jigs pa// 'phrog byed gzugs can 'ja' tshon gyi// gtsug gi nor bu khyod drung du// rdul phyags pa yi bya ba byed// de la 'chi med pa thams cad// a la la zhes lag brkyangs nas// manda ra ba'i char 'bebs shing*// lha yi dar gyis nam mkha' bkang*// zhes so// gzhan yang dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa'i rnam par thar pa'i cha shas cung zad thos pa'ang rdzong gsar du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig /mchad kha rab 'byams pa shākya blo gros la bka' stsal par/ mdang rmi lam du gung dkar thang du dmag gi phru ma chen po zhig btab 'dug pa 'di su yin/ zhes dris pas zhwa dmar ser gyi ste/ gtsang pa'i thog tu 'dren no zer de'i mod la padma 'od nas 'ongs pa yin bya ba zhig gis sgrom bu gcig gtad nas/ 'di mthon mthing cod pan rtse gsum gyi sgam yin re zhig khyod kyis zungs/ slar len du 'ong gsungs nas ga shed du gshegs pa rmis gsungs pa dang*| sngon spo bo'i dngul lung rdo khar bzhugs pa'i dus gnas po tshe ring rgyal pos zhus nas lung bstan rgyas pa zhig gnang ba der/ 'di ma shi gzhon rabs tshe ring na// don thams cad gser gyis khyab nas 'ong*// gsungs pa ltar thams cad thog tu ma bab pa med cing dar rtse mdor sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa chen po 'ong ba yang mkhyen nas/ phyag mdzod kyis tshong pa rnams nyer bsdogs grub kyang bshol ba na kha zer ba mang du byung yang tshong pa rnams dar rtse mdor slebs thog /sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa chen po byung bas thams cad kyis mngon par mkhyen par shes nas gus pa'i bsam pa rgya cher 'phel ba'ang mang du byung*/

yang sgom sde nang chen blo gros rgyal po mjal du 'ongs nas phyir 'gro kha khams phyogs kyi legs nyes kyi lung bstan zhus pa ltar stsal ba'i shog dril ring po zhig yod pa der ri bo che'i nyams chag /be ri rgyal po'i jus 'phar bub/ blo gros rgyal po rang yang dgra'i dbang du 'gro ba sogs lung bstan thog tu bab pa kho na byung zhing*/ mnga' ris rgyal sras mnga' bdag karma phrin las kyi ngor stod phyogs kyi lung bstan stsal ba la yang bod sog gi dus 'khrug chen po 'byung ba sogs gsal bar yod 'dug /sngon byang 'grul su byung yang ja 'dren sogs mi gnang ba la/ o lod bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i dpung chen po lhags pa'i tshe/ rwa sgreng dgon gong bla mar gnang sbyin rgya chen po dang bcas mdun bsu gnang ba yang ma 'ongs da lta'i gnas snang ji bzhin gzigs pa nyid kyis so// gzhan yang rang rang gi 'dod pa ltar dus gsum gyi 'gyur ba dge mi dge 'chi 'das ma 'ongs kyi skye ba lung ston sogs gsal bar bka' stsal te thams cad mngon du ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med la/ bla ma lho pa sprul sku/ bla ma mgar/ bla ma nags phu ba/ bla ma dkon mchog chos dbang grags pa/ bla ma rdzogs chen pa ngag dbang nam mkha' 'brug sgra bzang po don grub/ bla ma gsung snyan pa kun bzang rnam rgyal/ bla ma sbyin pa phun tshogs/ bla ma karma blo ldan rdo rje/ bla ma tshul khrims rin chen/ paṇa chen karma lung rigs rgya mtsho rnams la'ang ma 'ongs pa'i gnas snang ji bzhin mkhyen pas rang rang dang 'tsham pa'i bdag rkyen bsko bzhag lung bstan pa/ da lta thams cad mngon du gyur nas bzhugs pa lags so// de rnams ni go rim la ma ltos par rnam thar snga mar bka' ma stsal ba tshad mar gyur pa'i ngag las byung ba 'ga' zhig bris pa'o// yang tshigs su bcad pas 'di skad do// gang thugs sgrib bral ting 'dzin me long ngogs// dus gsum shes bya'i gzugs brnyan shar ba'i 'dzum// ci yang bstan tshe tshul rol kho na la// lta ba'i yid la ya mtshan cis mi skye// padma'i drung nas rings par 'ongs pa yi// nam mkha'i snying pos rang gi rigs kyi rtags| |ind+ra nī la bzhu ba'i cod pan de// khyod las gtams pa'i gnas kyis 'phongs pa snyam// phyogs gcig kho na lta ba'i 'dod sred can// mun par rgyu la legs pa'i lam bstan tshe// 'phya smod mngon sum 'jigs pa de mthong nas// rang gis rang la khrel bgad ma byas sam// gzhan gyi tshul la lta 'dod mig bgrad la// rang gi nyam nga'i lung bstan skyu ru ra// lag mthil stsal kyang ma rig mgo thog tu// bab tshe dad pa'i mchi ma lhung lags sam// rang nyid zhing khams gzhan la brje dgongs nas// zhal skyin sprul pa'i skyes mchog bdag gir mdzad// 'tsham par bstan pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams kyang*// bkye ba kun dga' sha na'i gos sogs bzhin// zhes so// da ni rdo rje'i gsung dngos kyi rang gi tshul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nas smras pa gsong po'i dga' ston zhes bya ba las mchog dman gyi rnam par thar pa'i yi ge ji ltar gzigs pa dang*/

'dir bskul ba po rnam gnyis kyi ngor sgro skur gyi skyon spangs nas bri bar zhal gyis bzhes nas/ rgyal dbang ratna'i rnam par 'phrul ba'i rnam grangs 'ga' zhig dang*/ skye ba la dbang 'byor bas sngon gyi las kyi lhag ma sbyangs pa'i tshul dang*/ slar shing lug rgyal gyi zla ba'i dmar po'i phyogs la sku bltams pa nas brtsams te/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa lnga sa phag hor zla dgu pa'i nang du nged kyis mngags pa'i bla ma drung lung rings pa la mdo mang gi lung stsal pa'i bar 'god par mdzad zin pas/ de nyid kyi 'phro las rang gis shes pa dang thos pa cung zad brjod par bya'o| |de yang sngon dus bla ma dam pa'i zhal dkyil dgyes par mjal zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi cung zad thos pas sgo phye ste/ slar nas kyang skyes bu dam pa la bsten pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa na rnyed par dka' ba nyid kyi phyir/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal las mdo sde sna tshogs pa'i skor ma thos pa skabs su bab pa'i dus su stsol bar gsol ba btab cing*/ rjes su gnang bar stsal kyang dam pa'i chos la ched du bya ba dman zhing rnam par g.yeng ba dang le lo'i dbang gis zhabs pad bsnyen par rngo ma thogs/ der ring zhig 'das pa rang gi ngo skyin du bla ma'i drung du 'khrul zhig ngag dbang las grub mngags pa la dgyes bzhin stsal ba dang lhan cig ji ltar smon pa ltar nan tan chen pos bla ma la lung bgyis mchis pa long med du ma lus par myur du khyod kyis kyang nyan par gyis shig ces bka'i glegs bu dang bcas phebs pa ji lta ba bzhin/ bdag gi skal ba'i snod du nod pa'i bka' drin thob la de nyid dang mi ring bar bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje rin po che la yang bdag gis phul bas bka' stsal chud ma zos pa tsam du rlom mo// yang smras pa/ 'phags pa'i yul lam gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang*// mkhas dang grub pa'i khyu mchog grangs med pas// bstan dang 'gro la bya ba cher mdzad pa'i// rnam par thar des khyed kyi thugs kyang 'phrog

/mkha' mnyam 'gro la snying rje'i spyan chab can// lus len skye ba'i tha ma rdzogs bsnyad nas// sprul pa brgya phrag dus gcig 'char ba la// bsnyon pa ci mchis rdzogs sangs rgyas de yang*// bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin thos sgrog la// bstan mod gang gi srid pa ji srid bar// sprul dang las kyang rgyun mi 'chad do zhes// mi pham seng ge'i dbyangs 'dir su zhig rgol// bzang po'i dus shig 'gru rgan se bo'i rgyud// so gad spom rar khrus byed 'chi med kyi// mdzes ma 'dus nas mkha' las bskyur ba'i brgyud// chos phyug yul du 'dam bu'i tshal bzhin byung*// nam gru ma yis bran gyi bya ba can// jo dpal 'dam las padma dkar po ltar// chos kyi sgrol ma gya gyur spyod pa de// tshul khrims rgya mtsho zhes pas rang gir gyur// de brgyud 'jigs mdzad grub dang rnal 'byor ma'i| |gser gyi gzhi la ri yi rgyal po bzhin// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon sogs ri bdun ltar// ches cher mtho ba'i gdung gi phreng ba byung*// las kyi lhag ma bdag gir mdzad pa la| |dngos sam drang ba'i don du 'char yod mod// rang nyams bzhin du rang dbang bsgyur ba 'di// dbang bcu brnyes pa rnams las gzhan gyis min// de nas thub pas ma bstan byang phyogs 'dir// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi mdzad pa bcus// bskal ba bzang po thams cad byang chub cher// bkod pa'i rnam par thar pa skyabs su mchi// thos kyang bsam sgom dben pa'i rgan po zhig /thal mo sbyar te zhu ba'i 'phrin gsan nas// mdo sde'i gaṅgā de ka dge ba'i bshes// gser gyi 'bab stegs brgyud de blo mtsho bkang*// zhes so// de dang mi ring bar 'og shod kyi 'brog sde rnams kyis tshogs zhing du spyan drangs te zu re dang lcong brgyud ra rgod sum mdor gnas po rig tshang gi lha zhol du chos kyi phru ma btab nas/ mchod sbyin gyi bgyi ba la gcig tu brtson pa'i 'byor ldan dag gis lus longs spyod dang bcas pa ni mchod pa'i sprin du spungs/

tshe pha rol tu gyur pa rnams kyi ming snyan gyi dbang por chud pa tsam gyis sgrib pa'i bud shing bsregs shing yang dag pa'i lam ni bstan/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyi bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po'i chu klung thams cad byang chub chen po'i rgya mtshor ro gcig pa nyid du mdzad/ kun kyang skyabs su 'gro ba sogs bslab pa'i gzhi la bkod/ bkra shis pa'i me tog sil ma'i char phab pas thams cad bde legs phun sum tshogs par ni rab tu gnas/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po tsa turbhu dza/ stobs 'phrog nag po chen po/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma/ sngags bdag sde dpon bco brgyad/ rtsi dmar sogs dgyes pa'i spyan gzigs kyis ni thugs dam bskangs shing phrin las bskul/ bod kyi skyabs gcig ma hā gu ru padma saṃ bha'i byin rlabs don gyi dbang bzhis mchog dman bar ma'i 'dus pa dbyar gyi rtswa skyes pa lta bu bgrang gis mi chod pa rnams ni smin pa dang grol ba'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzad do zhes thos so// skabs de rnams kyi tshe bla ma mchog nyid kyi mthus zhabs drung du 'khod pa'i blo gros kyi nor ldan rnams kyis rang rang gi bsam pa dang rjes su mthun par zhu ba'i spobs pa thob te gsol ba la/ 'brel gtam ltar gnang ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo mchog tu ngo mtshar ba 'di ltar bskor te/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sogs lhag pa'i lha mchog rnams kyi mtshan kho nas kyang nges don gyi zab gnas mang po ston pa yin te/ dper na 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes pa nyid mya ngan las 'das pa yin pas/ de nyid phyag rgya dang des chos thams cad la spang blang dgag sgrub dang bral bar rgyas thebs pa ni zil gnon te phyag rgya zil gnon no// zhes bya ba dang*/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral zhing bza' btung sogs kyang mchod rdzas su shes pas de la brten pa'i nyes pa mi 'byung*/ thams cad 'khor gsum rnam dag tu rtogs na tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa yin yang so so'i skye bo la dka'/

tha na go yul tsam ni med du mi rung la des kyang don chen po 'grub ces pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pas 'dag nges shing de las kyang sdig pa'i rang bzhin shes na 'dag phul che/ zhes pa dang*/ nged kyi rmi lam du mthil mgon khang du mgon po'i sku brnyan gyi mdun ka ba gdong ma'i rtsar kho bo 'dug pas gri rang la bsnun pa 'chi'am snyam pa byung ba bzang rtags ngan par bstan par go// de nas rtse ba'i tshoms kyi g.yon phyogs ka ba 'og ma'i gdong der 'dug pa'i g.yas phyogs su cog tse/ stan khra bo bting ba'i steng du bya rog cig 'dug pa'i sgal par bdag gis byil byil mang po byas pas/ bya rog gi kha nas me lhab lhab 'bar zhing snang ba rtags dngos gzhir 'dug /spyir du chos skyong bya rog ma 'di chos skyong thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bu yin mod 'phral 'khu ldog che gsungs pa dang*/ dpal stobs 'phrog nag po ni chos skyong bkra shis la phrin las myur| yi dam gshin rje'i gshed dang 'jam dpal rdo rje byed par shin tu 'go zhing 'brel mtshungs/ drang srong rā hu la ni spyir 'khu ldog mi 'byung la khyad par nged kyis bsnyen pa bgyis pas rtags thon/ gza'i nad can gyis gsang chab 'thung zhing khrus byas na de'i nad las grol/ nged la ni gza' klu sogs kyis 'khu ldog byung ma myong*/ phyag rgya chen po ni mdo sngags thun mong gi gseng lam yin/ tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas ni gsang sngags pho nya'i lam ma brten na mi 'grub cing*/ sngon gyi skyes chen phal cher yang de nyid la brten pa yin/ rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim na 'tshang rgya/ bar do'i 'od gsal ngos zin/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug thob nas sems can gyi don du bsam bzhin skye ba len zhing 'khor ba mtha' med du 'gro don rgyun mi 'chad pa yin gyis/ las dbang gis 'khor bar mi 'khyam/ yang dag 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas 'og min dang*/

ston pa rdo rje 'chang rigs lnga sogs kyang don dam pa rang gi sems rnam par dag pa'i rang mdangs tsam yin gyi bden par grub pa med ces bla ma dam pa dag gsungs/ rje btsun mi las snyun sgo la spos pa/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems nyid spros bral du shar ba'i rnam 'gyur yin/ chos thams cad kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum du bsdus nas rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung las 'chad mod/ kun rdzob sgyu ma dang don dam nam mkha' lta bur gcig par dbu ma pa chen po rnams bzhed/ stong pa nyid kyi don dngos su ma rtogs kyang mos pa tsam gyis kyang srid pa hrul por byed cing dkor dang sdig pa mang du 'byang ba yin no// zhes bya ba sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo yang dag par bskor ro// gnas chen rnams kyi do zla ni// rkang bzhi kun gyi gter 'dzin pa// bsod nams 'dod pa bsnyen bkur ched// lha zhol lha yi khyim 'drar gshegs// 'dod yon sna lnga'i mchod par sbyar// lam bzang pha rol gyur la bstan// tshe dang 'byor pa sems pa la'ang*// re ba kun nas gang bar mdzad// thub pa'i drung du de'i mthu las// gzhan du smra bar nus pa med// shes rab zil gyis mi gnon pas// nyan thos blo yi padma phyes/ dris pa kun gyi lan ldon pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas las yod ma yin// gsung gcig ral gris mi shes pa// thag pa'i dra ba dum bur byas// kā wu pa yi drag po'i me// log 'dren sreg la mched pa bzhin// bstan srung kun gyi ral pa'i khrod// rol stabs nor bu nyid du bsngags// 'jam dpal zhi khro'i phrin las pa// kha'u brag gi gzi ldan dbang*// gnyis skyes gzugs kyis khyod kyi mdun// byis pa gzhon nu bzhin du rgyu// mun chen ri gnas sde brgyad kyi// 'byung po gdon gyis gtses pa yang*// khro bo'i lta zer gcig nyid kyis// khor yug bar du 'bros par rtsom// bcu gsum rdo rje'i gzhal med du// bgrod par 'dod pa gang yin de// gsang chen 'pho med tshul khrims kyi// them skas ma bsten yod ma yin// chos sku sems su 'chad pa la// sems tsam zhes su phal cher 'dzer// 'di nyid 'khor dang myang 'das zhes// rdo rje 'chang gis ma bsgrags sam// de sogs tog dkar 'dren khyod kyis// shang kha'i sgra chen bsgrags pa na// ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi// rol mo thams cad chag pa bzhin// zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// de nas 'phags mchog thugs rje'i bdag po spyan ras gzigs dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul gyi padma'i gnyen phrin las rnam par dkar ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog tu 'bar bas rgya mtsho la thug gi bar gyi 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen dam par shar ba gang gis/

lho phyogs mthar byed kyi bdag po'i snyems pa 'phrog pa lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor las/ ṭīka chen rin chen phreng ba'i gsal byed gces pa'i 'khor lo bcu gsum gyi lag len gsal bar byed pa sngar stsal ba'i drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag gi zhal gdams lta bu zhig stsal du gsol/ zhes bka'i srub shing gis mkhyen brtse nus pa'i thugs kyi rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon zhes bya ba'i ha la ha la'i bum pa phyung ste bstan pa srung ba'i phyag mtshan du phul zhes kyang thos so// yang skabs shig thub mchog nyi ma'i gnyen gnyis pa des ched du pho nya ba mngags te/ bka'i glegs bu rgya gar mkhas pa'i lugs ltar dbang po'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor gyis bcings pa bzhed don rje ratna'i rnam thar sde tshan gsum dang*/ nyid kyis stsal ba'i 'jam dpal khro chu'i las byang log 'dren zil gnon/ de'i yig chung yang zlog gi skor gyi glegs bam g.yar gnang gi zhu gsol dang*/ dogs gcod kyi shog dril shin tu ring ba dang bcas stsal ba'i skabs/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i grags snyan gyis phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor khengs pa dang*/ stong chen phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa ston pa'i tshe/ 'gro mgon rdo rje rgyal po la 'khu bar nus pa khyod min pa su zhig ces pa dang*| snang bzhi'i chu bo 'ja' lus gser ldan gyi lto bar rgyun mi 'chad du 'bab par mdzad pa ni bai ro tsa na gnyis par nges pa dang*/ dpal 'bri gung pa chen po'i gdan sa chos srid mngon par mtho ba'i khri chen por bstan pa'i btsas su bskal brgyar zhabs pad brtan par gsol zhes nyi 'og gi rū pa srang bcu phrag lnga dang bcas stsal/ de gong pho brang chen po gru 'dzin du phebs pa'i tshe/ gshin rje'i sgrub pa dang*/ sos gtor gyi drag las phyag len bar skabs chag pa rnams kyang sngon bzhin ci bder mdzad du gnang ngo*// 'di skabs bdag gi'ang phyag dpe dgos phebs pa zhig 'bul ba dang*/

zab chos kyi gser khang sgo bcad ma 'di go mi bde ba zhig 'dug pas 'grel pa gsal ba zhig zhu 'bul dang*/ gso dpyad rgyud bzhi la mchan bu mchog tu ngo mtshar ba gnang 'dug pa'ang mjal zhing bshu ba sogs bgyis/ gter ston chen po pad gling pa'i gsum sprul tshul khrims rdo rjes bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma'i gsol mchod zhus pa'ang stsal| phyis gsum sprul snyung ba'i tshe'ang thugs dam brtags pa dang thugs yid gcig tu 'dres shing padma 'od du rig 'dzin gyi gral la 'khod pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa yang 'byor/ bla ma lho pa dkon mchog phrin las kyis bskul ba'i ngor dgongs pa gcig pa'i dka' 'grel tshigs su bcad pa mun sel sgron me dang*/ 'om 'od gsal sdings kyi bla ma kun spangs pa dang*/ sna ri spo spos gsol ba btab nas bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs 'bring po dang sbyar ba'i khro bo rol pa cha lag gdams phran dang bcas pa gnam lcags rdo rje'i thog chen dang*| hor zla bcu pa'i nang du dgongs pa yang zab zhi khro'i dbang phreng la mchan bu/ phag lnga'i tshogs kyi kha skong yang mdzad de/ de'i mjug tu/ chos kyi grags pa'i nyi 'od 'bar ba'i tshe// blo ldan padma'i tshal rnams brten re ran// rta bdun dbang po nub rir chas pa na// zla ba skar mas padma'i tshogs mi dbye// zhes stsal/ da yang zab kyi zhal 'phangs kha 'gengs dgos pa ci yang med ces dgongs pa rdzogs pa ltar mdzad do// de rnams kyi tshul tshigs su bcad de slar smras pa/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la gser mngal gyis// bskul gyi gzhan gyis nus pa min// sangs rgyas rgyal rnams 'gro ba ni// 'dul phyir yin gyis the tshom min// bdud las nges par rgyal ba'i yang*// rang dang mtshungs pa gzhan la yang*| |gus dang rgya cher bsngags mthong ste// 'od dpag med kyi mdo sde bzhin// mang la rig 'dzin sgra 'jug kyang*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo lngas// gang ba thams cad mkhyen pa las| |don bzhin rung ba su zhig yod// lus med gshin rje gtum po'i dpung*// rdul phran tsam du byed pa yin// grags pa rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i sgras// 'dzam bu gling pa'i rna ba gang*| |padma rgyal po rdo rje rgyal// rnam par snang mdzad srung ba ltar// rgyal tshab phyag rgya grub pa dang*// 'ja' lus brnyes pa da gdod shes// de sogs bsngags pa'i me tog dang*// rin po che yi skyes dang bcas// brtan par bzhugs la gsol ba btab// padma gling gi rnam 'phrul des// padma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// padma 'od kyi zhing khams su// padma'i go 'phang bskyel bar gsol// nyon mongs nad rnams 'chos la sman// ngan 'gro srid las skyob pa'i gdugs// skyon drug spangs pa'i legs bshad kyi// bstan bcos glegs bam rgya cher spel| |zhes so// de nas bla ma mgar sku skye/

khams skyo nang so/ ban grong sku skye sogs dang*/ khams phyogs kyi dad 'dus mang ba la/ kun rig gi cho ga'i ljags lung sogs so so'i 'dod pa tshim par mdzad de/ mgar sku skye bla chas bzang po dang bcas khams phyogs kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed du brdzangs/ lho nas gsum sprul thugs sras zla ba grags pa slob mar bcas te zhabs drung du 'bul nod bzang po dang bcas 'byor ba la/ dgongs pa yang zab glegs bam thog tha bar gsum bsdus lung dang*/ rtsa gsum gtor dbang bsdus pa gnang*/ gnang sbyin bzang po dang gzengs bstod bslab bya rgya cher stsal/ rtsed thang nas paṇa chen karma lung rigs rgya mtsho'i byang zhu'i rten gser zangs kyi bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs 'byor/ sprul sku ngos 'dzin gyi phyag bris kyang gnang*/ sna ri spo spos zla gsang rgyud las/ dur khrod ras la dpa' bo'i gzugs// tshon rtsi spyin med bzang po yis// mkhas pas yab yum sras bcas bri// zhes sogs bris sku ji skad gsungs pa ltar bsgrubs/ 'bri gung mthil/ sgar stod smad/ bya yul/ mal gro/ klung shod kyi dgon sde thams cad la mang ja/ sku 'gyed bcas bzang po stsal/ mthil ma dgon la spyan gzigs mnga' gsol brgya tshar mdzad/ gtsug lag khang rnams la dkar me sogs brgya bzhi/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i sku brnyan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi tshems mche ba snying por chud pa gser khang chos rjer grags pa rten ma lus pa'i gtso bo lha dang bcas pa'i phyag gi gnas de nyid dang*/ khang gsar 'og tu dngul gdung rin po che'i drung du snyan dar dang mchod rdzas dngul gyi maṇḍal rgyan ldan che 'bul/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo mchog gi 'dren pa chen pos bka' stsal ltar lcags sdig gi bca' gzhi lag len gsar rtsom/ yang zlog gi gsol gdab/ mnga' gsol/ bskang bshags/ zlog byang*/ bsnyen sgrub spyi'i yig chung zhal gdams sogs kyi phyag dpe phul/

gong du lha ldan gru 'dzin gyi pho brang chen por sangs rgyas nang zhal dgyes par mdzad/ hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer dgu la yar phebs lam brag ral gru kha dang mtha' rgyas kyi zhag sa gnang skabs skyid 'phen gyi mi phal mo che'i yid mos tshal dkyil rdo rje zla ba'i bdud rtsi 'thung du 'ongs pa la nyin rangs phyag lcag gnang zhing*| rang rang gi 'byor pa dang mthun pa'i mchod pas mchod de mthong thos dran reg byang chub chen por nges pa dkar ba gcig pu'i snang ba mu med pa'i bka' drin stsal nas tshim pa thob/ de dgong mi tshan po che 'dus pa thams cad kho bor blta ba'i ched 'ongs pa las gzhan min/ de thams cad kyi nang na mi 'chi ba ni gcig kyang med/ kho bo yang phyogs 'dir phyin chad sleb pa min| 'ong ba'i rting ma yin/ rgyal mchog thams cad gzigs pa chen po dang da res las mjal ba mi 'ong gsungs pa la/ dge slong ra khyim pa sogs kyis de ltar gsung ba rten 'brel la yang gnod/ rgyal ba mchog kyang yang yang mjal ba'i thugs 'dun gnang dgos zhus kyang ci yang mi gsung*/ de nas btsun tshal chos skyong sku rten gyis la mor spyan drangs nas mchod pa rgya cher byas/ sku rang phebs te 'phral phugs kyi bka' bgro ba mang du zhus/ sku rten yang mi rabs gsum gyi bar du lha gnas su mi 'pho ba'i dam bca' byas/ bla ma chen po zhabs brtan pa'i gsol 'debs tshigs bcad kyang bgyis/ de nas rtse ba sra brtan rdo rje'i pho brang du zhabs pad 'khod do// de rnams la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sgom ring rtogs pa'i bdud rtsi yis// myos des sa yi cho ga ltar// mdzad pa dri zhim len pa'i shing*// ri nas ri la slebs pa yod// de yi ma 'ongs shes pa'i blos// rang gi slob mar gdams pa las| |mgon po klu yis bzung ba na// sngon med grub pa'i dkyil 'khor byung*// de nyid snyigs ma'i nyes pa yi// chu bo zlog la chu lon ltar// mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal ba// khyod nyid yin la klan ka ci// chos rje'i zhal skyin dngos ji bzhin// chos sku'i rten mchog 'dzam gling rgyan// chos srung ye shes spyan ldan bcas// chos kyi gzhi 'di rdo rje'i gdan// de rnams dus dang rnam kun tu// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis// mchod de kun gyi bsod nams dang*// ye shes kun nas rgyas par gyur// ston pas rab dga' rab bzang gnyis// tha ma'i gdul byar smin yin mod// 'di na tshwa tshi bka' brgyud du// 'dug pa thams cad rnam grol mdzad// deng gi dus kyi mchog dang dman// ma mthong lta la mig dang ni// ma thos dri la rna lce bzhin// tshad mar byed pa'i lha chen yod// de yis sdum par spyan drangs shing*// 'gro ba'i bla ma zhabs brtan pa'i// gsol 'debs nga yang yun ring du// 'tsho ba'i khas len byed do skad// ces so// rgyal ba thams cad kyi mdzad pa'i mchog ni yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba chen po yin te/

tshul des 'dul ba'i gdul bya grangs med pa yod pa'i phyir ro// de yang bar do dang zhing gzhan gyi 'gro ba yod pa bzhin du gdon mi za bar nges pa grangs med 'dul ba'i dus gzigs/ le lo can rnams brtson pa bskyed cing rtag par lta ba rnams sun dbyung ba'i phyir zhing gzhan du thugs mngon par phyogs pa na/ de'i tshul gyi mtshan ma sa gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis shes nas mir gyur pa la mtshon pa ni nye ba'i 'thung spyod tsā ri yul smad dang*/ sgrub sde de'u rin chen spungs pa'i bar gyi nags tshal nyams dga' ba shwa 'ud kyis khyer te grog por song*/ phag mo gru kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du zla ba bcu gnyis pa la stag ma'i me tog gis dpyid kyi dpal 'dzin/ 'on du ston mjug kham bu dang ku shu'i me tog sos ka'i dus ltar rgyas/ rin chen brag gi rgyab ri'i spang ngos su sngar mi yong ba'i me tog spang rgyan gyis sa'i mdog mthing gi gzhi ltar byas/ phyag mdzod dang*/ bla ma mtsho skyes/ sprul sku'i yum rnams kyi rmi lam du nyi zla gzas bzung ba/ mun sros pa/ nyi zla thang la lhung ba/ bzhugs sgar bteg pa sogs byung*/ snyung bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus dbang po'i gnam ru kha dog lnga ldan gyis gang du spyod pa'i gzhal med khang g.yogs pa/ ra khyim dgon pa ba phal cher gyis mthong*/ dgun dkyil dbyar gyi rnga bo che ldir ba mtshan mo 'ja' dkar po zug pa sogs byung*/ rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes gsum la lha chen dung thod can rang bab tu byas te/ lag g.yas g.yon gyis ru dar gnyis rgyang ring du 'phangs/ mthe bo'i dung long brdabs te phye mar byas/ 'od ma'i gzhu pus mo la bkan nas bcag |khrab gdan rkyang pa gyon nas 'o dod gnam du 'bod bzhin dbur stod phyogs su 'chor ba ltar byed de stag rtse nas mi dbang chen po'ang the tshom du gyur nas nged cag la nyes pa ma mchis sam zhes gsol bas/

khyod la mi lta 'gro ba'i nyi ma nub pa'i ltas yin zhes bsgrags so// de gong nas mang rar lho ru rnams kyis spyan drangs pa'i tshe zhabs 'bring ba rnams kyis lcags zam la gshegs bshul shin tu bde ba sogs bkur sti rmad du byung ba bgyis pa'i tshul gyis da 'dod ltar na lo gcig gnyis bsdad na'ang bsam zhing gsungs/ yang sha khrag gi longs spyod la gzigs nas 'gro phan la bsnyad pa'i sdig pa 'di lta bu bas shi ba 'dam gsung*/ zhing 'dir mi bzhugs pa'i dgongs pa glo bur du 'khrungs pa 'dra zhes kyang dpyod pa dang ldan pa dag smra'o// de rnams la yang 'di skad bya ste/ bskal mang gong nas byang chub spyod pa la// spyad de mya ngan thams cad spangs zin kyang*// de las 'da' ba'i rnam thar 'dir ston pa| |gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs las gzhan ci zhig /'on kyang zhing 'di'i yid mkha'i me long du// gzugs sku'i snang ba re zhig yol ba'i tshul// bem por gyur pa rnams kyang ma bzod na| |sems bcas snying ni rdo bar song min nam// mkha' 'gro'i gar gyi do ra ngam grog gyur// dus las yol ba'i chu skyes bris pa bzhin// sngon med utpal sngon pos sa gzhi gang*// 'ja' tshon dbyar gyi rnga chen dus min du// kye ma skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba zhes// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis yang yang gdams pa ni// rang nyid de la 'jigs pa ga la yin// 'o skol rtag par lta la bskul ba nyid// sdig pa byed la snying rje gus ldan la// dgyes pa gshegs dang bzhugs pa'i gsung 'di ltar// rdzu 'phrul rkang par bsnyen goms bskul ba dang*// yid srub mos pa bkang ba mtshungs min nam// zhes so// hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gsum bcu bzhi skor zhig la dge slong ra khyim pa dang*/ gsol dpon la/ mdang rna ba gnyis nas 'ur sgra chen po zhig gi rkyen byas dbugs rgyu ba mi mngon lus sgul bskyod mi nus/

'phar rtsa rnams kyang mi 'phar/ tshogs drug gi yul snang ma 'gag la der 'dzin ma zhugs pa'i bde stong zung 'jug tu gnas pa yun ring byung*/ dge slong rlung gis snyung ba'i skabs de ltar ma byung ngam gsungs pa la/ bdag la de lta bu ma byung ba ci yin nam zhus pas| rnal 'byor pa rlung bsgoms pas rlung dbu mar tshud pa'i rtags su bshad/ ngas rlung rtsol ni ma byas gsungs/ khong gis da lta rlung rtsol ma gnang yang lam goms pa yin pas rtsol ba gnang ci dgos zhus pas/ de ga red ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar thim pa'i rtags yin pa 'dra gsungs shing de rjes kyang thengs 'ga' byung*/ tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin sngags 'chang mchog grub rgyal po la byang gter 'chi bdag zlog byed stobs chen gyad kyi mdos de gtong dgos pa 'dug /rdzas 'di lta bu sogs/ de'i rgyab chog dgos pa dge slong ra khyim pas gyis gsungs pa la/ dge slong gis rgyu mtshan zhus pas ltas log pa min yang*/ khams ma bde zhig byung*/ spro lung gi bde bar gshegs pa de yang zla ba 'di'i tshes bcu bdun la bsnyungs pas zla sri lta bu yin nam gsungs/ mkha' 'gro'i bsus zlog /sku glud sogs mdos rigs mang ba zhig bgyid du stsal/ dge slong gis grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe sgrub zhag gsum byas shing*/ tshe ril sogs la ljags reg tsam gnang nas phyag mdzod dang dge slong sogs la longs spyod du bcug /bsam yas chos skyong gis sgrol dkar tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma zhig gnang dgos tshul byung ba ltar sku mtshams bcad rgya mdzad/ snyel zug med kyang gsol dang 'gag /mthil sku 'dra rin po che'i spyan gnyis nas spyan chab bab pa dang sngar gyi ltas rnams kyis thams cad yid mi bde bar gyur nas/ phyag mdzod dang dge slong gnyis nye skor gyi dgon pa phal mo che la mang 'gyed/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog sgrog pa/ mdo brgya/ gser 'od brgya tshar/

padma bka' thang brgya tshar/ sātstsha 'bum ther/ sher snying*/ sgrol ma/ tshe gzungs rnams 'bum ther/ khro rol mgon po sogs kyi zlog pa/ chos skyong rnams kyi bskang rgyun mnga' gsol spyan gzigs 'bul ba/ bla ma grwa rigs mi sde dang bcas pa thams cad kyis nyin re bzhin brtan bzhugs rgyun ma chad par phul/ kun gzigs rgyal ba mchog gi bkas bskul ba'i gshin rje lcags sdig gi man ngag gab dkrug gsal bar bsgrigs pa phul ba la thugs kyi dgyes pa chen pos/ sngon med kyi legs bshad pad gnubs ring lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyi khyad nor zla med pa'i legs bshad gnang ba spro dga' brtas/ snyun cung zad ldang ba'i tshul ston pa bstan 'gro'i don du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i thugs 'dun gtod pa dang*/ de ltar gsol ba yang yang 'debs so zhes gnang rten bzang po dang bcas stsal/ bla ma rin po che de nyid sngar stag lung gi gnas gzigs la phebs bzhed kyi bka' stsal yod pa ltar/ de'i bag chags 'dra zhig gis bdag gi rmi lam du'ang stag lung yang dgon du phebs 'dug pa re zhig bzhugs par zhu snyam pa las/ glo bur du gtsug lag khang chen po'i nub byang gi zur du gshegs par mthong ste bzhugs pa na/ glang po che'i lta stangs kyis gzigs shing sku chos kyi grwa bshad pa 'dra zhig mdzad de ga shed du phebs song ba rmis pas yid mi bde bzhin gnas pa na| sku rim gyi bka' shog phebs pas blong blong por gyur nas brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs la brtson pa bgyid blo byas/ yid la gang shar gyi tshul thams cad sba bsri med par dge slong dan pa la yi ge lag bris byas te bsrings/ thams cad kyis zhabs brtan pa'i zhal bzhes zhus pa la'ang ched gnyer mi mdzad/ pho brang gi bkrag nyams pa sogs ltas mi dge ba byung tshul zhus pa la ni dgyes pa ltar ston/ sngar chab kyi snyun lci ba bzhes tshe sman pa rnams la sman 'di sbyor bka' stsal pa ltar bgyis pa'i mod la dwangs pa yin yang 'di skabs sman pas gang zhus las ci yang bka' mi stsol/

mdzad pa thams cad 'phro brtul/ ngo mtshar mchog gi sprul pa'i sku sngon bzhin mngon sum snang ba dag la 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma nas bar ma chad pa'i byin rlabs don gyi 'pho ba stsal/ bstan pa'i bdag por don gyi mnga' gsol/ dgongs pa yang zab dang gshin rje'i yang zlog sogs kyi dpe dbang dang bka' gtad gnang*| nyin gcig sku 'khor 'ga' res snyun gsol ba na/ lus gcong nad kyis rtag tu 'tshe na yang*// sems re dogs med pa'i rdzogs pa che// don spang blang ma dgos nga re skyid// tshe 'di snang bar do phyi ma gsum// tshig gnas skabs kyi sa mtshams ma gtogs pa// don sems nyid gsal rdzogs chos sku la// 'pho 'gyur dang chags 'dzin mi gda' bas// ya nga dang bag tsha med pas skyid// lar ji ltar byas kyang stabs bde ba// lha rtsa gsum srung ma'i byin rlabs gda'// tshul gang yang grogs su 'gro ba 'di// mgon 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo'i thugs rje gda'// tshul des na ji ltar byas kyang skyid// lar skyid gsum ldan pa'i ban rgan nga'i// don gnas lugs kyi rgyud tshod de ltar lags// mgo nag phal cher padme hūm̐// zhes gsungs| dgong zhig zhal rlung gi rgyu ba chad pa ltar ci yang mi gsung bar bzhugs pas/ thams cad tab tab por gyur nas rlung bcos 'bul bar brtsams pas de ltar lags/ de 'dra ma byed ngas rtsed mo byas pa yin gsungs/ snyel zug ni ci yang ma mchis/ sku rked yan la chab kyi gzhi yang med/ gsung cher mi 'byon zhing spyan lta stangs bcas shing ting 'dzin las mi g.yo/ re 'ga' phyag thugs kar thal mo sbyar te de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho'i bkod pa gzigs par gdon mi za/ phyag mdzod rnam dag dang*/ dge slong dan pa gnyis las gzhan med pa'i skabs dge slong gis phyag mdzod ni dgongs pa rtse gcig pa gtad de bskos/ bdag gis lo brgyad nas zhabs phyir 'brangs/ gnyis kas ci gsung gi bka' bsgrubs/

dam tshig nyi ma sprin med kyis 'khyol/ des na bstan 'gro spyi dang khyad par bdag gnyis sogs gdul byar gyur pa rnams la dgongs nas sku tshe brtan par bzhugs dgos zhus pas/ sku khrong mdzad de khyed gnyis bden/ bdag cag gi ston pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshe/ steng gi sangs rgyas ded dpon zhes bya bas sgra gcan 'dzin khyod smre sngags ma 'don/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyang mya ngan las 'da'i khyod kyis ston pa'i sras kyi bya ba byas zin gsungs pa ltar/ nga gzhan dang 'dra ba'i bla ma min/ yin min phyis gsal nas 'ongs/ des na khyed gnyis kyang byas pa don med ma yin gsungs/ der phyag mdzod mchi mas brnangs/ dge slong gis slar nan gyis zhus te/ phyag mang du byas pas bzhad pa dang lhan cig a kyang ku re byas pa yin/ da res skyon mi yong gsungs/ skabs shig dge slong gis sku'i skye ba'i gsal kha zhig gnang dgos zhus pas/ skye ba las sla gsung ba tsam las zhal chems rgyas par ma stsal/ tshes bcu bdun la mkhan slob chos gsum/ sgar stod smad kyi bla ma khri zur/ 'brong pa bla ma/ be ri sku skye sogs la zhal bstan/ thams cad kyis bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas da zhag bzhi tshun la skyon ma byung na de nas sman yang za mi dgos gsungs skad/ de rnams la 'di skad bya ste/ gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i thab rlung sems gsum pa/ dhū ti ye shes rlung dang spros bral gyi// dpyid du dag pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa 'di// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes tshul lags// 'on kyang bdag cag byis pa'i blo 'gengs phyir// 'chi bzlog tshe bsgrub sku yi rim gro sogs// dang du bzhes mod rgan pos 'bag la ltar// ku re gzigs bsam gang du'ang ma gzigs snyam// sgra gcan 'dzin ni bu yin kun dga' bo// go re long zhes phyogs bcu'i rgyal la bcol// de bzhin 'dir yang brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur can// bla ma'i sdug pa'ang bla ma ltar mdzod cig

/gsung skyes tha chung grangs su tshud 'dir yang*// dag pa'i zhing du gshegs kha'i sku'i dkyil 'khor// ston pa tsam gyi skal ba mi gcod pa// kye hud bdag gi gus pa'ang gzigs lags grang*// 'od srung rang gi chos kyi khrir bzhag nas| |sangs rgyas nyid kyi bya ba bcol ba bzhin// don brgyud nyams pa med pa'i 'pho ba de// sprul pa'i skyes mchog 'di la 'phos par shes// zhes so// sa phag hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi srod la rgyun gtor rnams sku mdun du bshams pa bsngos nas chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams la bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgo bar mdzad de/ dar cig lon pa dang sku drang por bsrangs/ phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol nas zhal dbugs ring po nang du brngubs nas phyir ma dbyung ba'i ngang du dbu dpral gyi rtsa gsum hral gyis rgyas/ spyan gnyis zim bur chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs 'od gsal 'gro 'ong dang bral ba'i ngang du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i cho 'phrul ston par mdzad do// de'i nub mo sku gdung rin po che la reg thug med par bzhugs su gsol/ phyi nyin nyi dros bla ma mnga' bdag rgyal sras rin po ches zhal bkod mdzad de/ phyag mdzod drung dang gsol dpon dkon mchog kun ldan/ rin chen dar rgyas gsum gyis rin po che dang dar gyi yol khri steng du spyan drangs/ thabs shes kyi rang bzhin rdor dril phyag tu phul/ pur ras dang sku sbyar sogs na bza' dang rgyan gyi khyad par du mas brgyan/ bla bre dang ba dan dang*/ khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang*/ sbyar ba dang yongs su gyur pa'i spos dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ dri bzang po'i yon chab dang*/ me tog gi phung po dang*/ rol mo la sogs mchod pa'i bye brag thams cad tshar du dngar bar bkod/ sdom pa gsum ldan gyi 'dus pa brgya dang brgyad kyis dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/

zhi khro rigs bsdus dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrug pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas sgrub cing mchod la sku khrus gsol ba dang*/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ gsol 'debs dang smon lam gsung sgrog phyag skor la sogs zhag zhe dgu'i bar du bar ma chad par bgyis so// zla ba phyi ma'i tshes bcu bdun gyi snga dro yan lag lnga'i 'bras bu dge ba la sgar stod smad gzhi byes kyi bla ma khri zur/ mthil mkhan slob chos gsum/ lcam drung dang phyag mdzod/ gsol gzims sogs ban skya brgya phrag tsam gyi dbus su rje'i thugs sras blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas shing rje bla ma nyid kyi phyag khrid phyag len la mkhas pa mnga' ris dkon mchog lhun grub kyis zhugs 'bul ba'i rdo rje slob dpon mdzad de/ tho rangs dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bdag bskyed rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro ba'i las bum bsgrubs/ gdung sreg thab du spyan drangs tshe sngar bas lcir song zhing mdangs 'bar ba byung*/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas gdung yid bzhin nor bu nyid lha'i dkyil 'khor chen por gsal ba'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' bskyed de/ ye shes dkyil 'khor dgug gzhug bcing mnyes mchod bstod kyi bar bsgrubs/ pur gyi ye shes pa gnyis gshegs rjes tsandan dkar dmar dang*/ a ka ru la sogs pa'i bud shing dri bzang po lce lde sbar/ mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas kyi tshogs phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin du sprul nas legs par sbyangs pas/ thog ma'i bud shing dang yam shing nyung ngu de rnams ma gtogs gzhan nyer bsdogs kyi bud shing gang yang ma dgos par phyogs mtshams thams cad nas dkar zhing dri bzang po dang bcas pa'i byin za'i phung po rang 'bar gyis nyi ma shar nas nyin phyed ma zin gong du yongs su dag par gyur to// de'i tshe nam mkha' mthon mthing las lha rnams kyis me tog gi char chen po phab/

dud pa rnams kyang mkha' dbyings mthon por song nas mthar shar phyogs su 'gro ba dang*/ bya rgod zung gcig dma' bar 'ongs nas pur dud la bskor zhing mthar dbang po'i phyogs su chas pa dang*/ mjug tu chu 'dzin cung zad 'dus pa'ang kha dog lnga'i mdangs gsal bar gyur nas nyi ma gang nas 'byung ba'i phyogs su myur por rgyu bar snang ngo*// bdun bdun gyi tshigs dang bco brgyad kyi tshes byung res ze 'bru'i phreng ldan gyi char dang*/ 'ja' 'od kyis nam mkha'i khyon thams cad khyab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma ni grangs med par gyur to// de nas gdung khang gi sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas btab ste gdugs rgyal mtshan dang*/ bla bre dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pas dgung dang gdugs bco lnga'i bar du mchod nas zhal phye ba na gdung rus dang gdung thal shin tu nyung ngur song*/ gdung rus cung zad dang*/ gdung thal dad ldan rnams la bkye ba las phyis ring bsrel mang du phebs shing*/ gdung lhag ma rnams rten gyi nang bzhugs kyi ched du za ma tog tu bzhugs su gsol ba'ang ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur to// zhes grags so// de rnams tshigs su bcad de brjod pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal po sde bzhi por// bstan pa rin chen sgrom bu bcol ba ltar// gtor mgron so gnyis dbang po de rnams la// bka' yi khur chen bkal la the tshom ci// kye hud 'gro ba'i nyi ma gang du gshegs| |'khor ba 'jig po'i ring lugs yid bzhin nor// bdag pos btang ba bzhin du bor ba lags// slan chad nges don phyag rgya su yis sgrog /kun bzang padma'i rjes su 'jug pa'i gtam// brjod pas 'dzer ba da dung 'ga' mchis mod// sbyor sgrol chos su gleng ba tsam zhig las/ /a ti yo ga'i bdud rtsi su la re// gsung rab kun gyi brjod bya chos kyi sdom| |rnam lngar bsdus nas skal bzang dga' ston dang*// khyad chos brgya dang bcu phrag dgur spro ba'i// legs bshad rnga 'di khyed kyis bskyur phod dam// sgyu lus lha yi za ma tog spangs kyang*// bri gang med pa'i ye shes nyi ma zhig

/ring por min par shar nas bdag cag gi// snying gi mun pa myur bar bsal du gsol// phyi ma'i mdzad pa 'di ltar bstan nas kyang*// mang po bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis la// sbyor ba thub pa'i phrin las dam pa'i phyir// thams cad gsol ba 'debs la 'bad par mdzod// ces so| |de nas phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs bgrang gis mi lang ba bsdus te/ so so nas rang rang gi tshul lugs ji lta ba bzhin du gsar rnying gi dkyil 'khor rab tu mang po cho ga'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs pas sgrub pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mchod 'bul gsol 'debs gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gyi rim pa mang po zhag bcu gcig gi bar du bgyis shing*/ gral dbur/ stag lung nas zhabs drung khri rin po che spyan drangs pa la 'bul nod chen po bgyis te mchod bsngo smon lam dang bcas par mdzad/ 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal mchog phyag na padmo'i zhabs gtso bor gyur pa'i skyes bu dam pa thams cad kyi drung du thugs dam bskul ba'i 'bul nor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi dge 'dun gyi sde ma lus par mang 'gyed sogs mchod sprin gyi sgo brgya phrag du ma rnams rgyal po li byin chen pos rgyal dbang ratna'i zhabs 'bring du phul ba'i bla ma gdan gcig pa'i skye ba/ chung ngu nas lugs zung gi blo gros kyi padmo shin tu rgyas shing*/ rje'i thugs kyi sras dam pa phyag mdzod dge slong snang gsal ba dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*/ sgo gsum longs spyod dang bcas pas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs 'degs mnyes pa legs par grub pa'i dge slong dan pa gnyis kyis rtsa ba'i khur blangs bgyis shing*/ dad pa dang gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa'i bla ma grwa rigs sbyin bdag rab tu mang pos zhabs btegs nas/ dngul gdung rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu sku tshad rgyan bkod bzo spros phyag tshad phun sum tshogs pa/

gser gdugs khyad par can dang bcas pa yun thung ngu nyid kyis dge bar grub ste/ gtso bor gdung yungs 'bru tsam gyi ring bsrel ji snyed dang*/ chos sku'i ring bsrel ji snyed pa dang*/ sku bal gyi ring bsrel rab tu mang por bzhugs pa| gzhan yang bstan pa spyi bye brag gi byin rlabs kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas yongs su bskor zhing byur bur bkang*/ rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po dang 'brel ba'i rab tu gnas pa bkra shis dga' ston gyis brgyan pa legs par bsgrubs/ mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i bkod pas dus rtag tu mchod de lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i phyag gi gnas/ mchod pa'i zhing*/ bsod nams gsog pa'i yul du srid pa ji srid bar bzhugs su gsol/ dngul gdung rin po che bzhengs pa dang lhan cig sngar gyi srol rgyun ltar dzambu'i gling gi sa'i lte ba gangs ri ti ser gser gdung bzhengs par rje nyid kyi thugs dam mchod gshom pa dge slong dkon mchog rab brtan mched bcas rnams phyag mdzod nas rdzong bkod mdzad/ khong grogs mched kyis kyang lam gyi dka' ba dang ngal dub khyad du bsad nas ring por ma thogs par gnas su bgrod/ mkhar dpon rdo rje rgya mtsho yab yum gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyin bdag dad pa can rnams dang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po lha btsun ga ga la sogs pa bla ma che phra dang grwa rigs rnams kyis ci 'dod pa'i mthun rkyen ma tshang ba med pa bsgrubs te/ gser zhun ma shin tu mthug pos g.yogs pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten gser gdung snga ma rnams las sku tshad dang bzo khyad phun sum tshogs pa bde blag tu grub/ nang bzhugs su 'bul rgyu'i gdung rus zhal phye bas sngar med kyi ring bsrel ngo mtshar can mang du byon pa der 'dus kyi gzhi byes thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub pas phyogs de'i skye bo mtha' dag gi dad pa lhag par 'phel ba'i gsos su gyur to zhes grags so// thugs rje'i bdag po spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par 'phrul ba bsam bzhin du srid pa nye bar bzung ba sprul pa'i skyes chen dkon mchog phrin las bzang po chos kyi seng ge'i khrir/
